_about: What CDR sells and at what price, read by the site (apps/web) AND by the API (apps/api), both through @cdr/shared. One file so the price the server charges can never drift from the price the page shows. Edit here, then rebuild both apps.
_sellable: The extensions the shop sells online, and the only ones the search offers to register (plan D6). Add one only after a test registration of it on Horizon. Everything else is answered with 'contact us'.
_notSoldOnline: Extensions whose registry needs data the checkout does not collect: OpenSRS's sw_register tld_data list (read 23 Sep 2026), plus .ca, which needs CIRA's legal_type (PROJECT.md decision 12 D6). A cart line on one of these is refused before payment, never charged and then failed.
_countries: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, every assigned code: the registrant's country, which OpenSRS takes as a two-letter code. The page names them with Intl.DisplayNames.
